name: Pimlico
description: The dominant ERC-4337 bundler and paymaster infrastructure for EVM chains. Submits UserOperations to the AA mempool and sponsors gas for users. The default AA infrastructure layer in Base and Ethereum consumer apps.

ecosystem_fit.notes: Default AA infrastructure for Base consumer apps. Paired with Privy in the canonical gasless onboarding stack.
Production-grade bundler and paymaster for Ethereum mainnet and L2s.
Used for gasless actions inside Farcaster miniapps on Base.
ERC-4337 is EVM-only. Solana has a different account model — gasless patterns on Solana require different approaches.

common_pairings.context: Privy creates the embedded wallet; Pimlico sponsors gas for the first transactions. The canonical gasless consumer onboarding pairing.
ZeroDev provides the smart account (Kernel) with session keys; Pimlico provides the bundler and paymaster infrastructure that submits ZeroDev UserOperations.
Pimlico for AA infrastructure; Alchemy for the underlying RPC and chain data. Standard EVM production stack.
Dynamic for wallet management; Pimlico for gasless transaction sponsorship in AA flows.
OnchainKit UI for transaction components; Pimlico handles the gas sponsorship layer underneath.

trust_evidence.description: Pimlico is the dominant ERC-4337 bundler/paymaster provider. Cited as the default AA infrastructure in Base and Ethereum production stacks.
Privy + Pimlico is the most frequently confirmed gasless onboarding pattern in WORKFLOWS.md. Pimlico appears in every production AA workflow.
Pimlico maintains the permissionless.js SDK (the canonical open-source ERC-4337 SDK) and comprehensive bundler/paymaster documentation.
Integrated by ZeroDev (bundler), Biconomy (competitor with similar patterns), Safe (smart account), and referenced by Privy documentation as the recommended paymaster.

scale_guidance.hackathon: Use Pimlico's free tier for hackathons. Simple policy: sponsor all transactions.
scale_guidance.mvp: Define gas policy early: per-user daily limits, per-transaction caps. Unbounded sponsorship is a budget risk.
scale_guidance.production: Model gas sponsorship cost per user before launch. Implement per-user spending limits. Plan for bundler SLA — Pimlico uptime is critical if gasless UX is a product promise.

alternatives.when_to_prefer: When kernel-level smart account features (session keys, plugin system) are required, not just bundler/paymaster. ZeroDev bundles smart account + bundler + paymaster; Pimlico is bundler + paymaster only.
When fully in the Alchemy ecosystem and prefer single-vendor infrastructure for RPC + AA.

anti_patterns: Using Pimlico for Solana — ERC-4337 does not apply to Solana. Gasless patterns on Solana require a different approach.
Not setting per-user spending limits — an unlimited paymaster policy is a budget vulnerability at scale.
Treating Pimlico as a smart account provider — Pimlico is a bundler/paymaster. Smart account logic (session keys, plugins) requires ZeroDev Kernel or Safe.
Skipping bundler failure handling — Pimlico's bundler can reject UserOperations; agents and apps must handle rejection gracefully.
